chunk: David Hughes was born on January 7, 2005, in Nova Scotia, Canada. Growing up in a small coastal town, David developed a strong sense of community and a love for the outdoors. He spent most of his childhood exploring the rugged coastline and helping his parents with their small bakery, where he discovered his passion for baking.
